title: The Mel Blanc Show
paragraphs: One-season CBS situation comedy starring Mel Blanc as a fictionalized Fix-It Shop owner. The historical run contains 43 Tuesday broadcasts; the frozen GRH preservation set has 42 recordings and carries a documented Jan. 14/Jan. 21 chronology disagreement around Foreign Relatives.
GRH documents the program through CBS / Colgate run (September 3, 1946 to June 24, 1947) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Mel Blanc (performer on 42 recordings), Mary Jane Croft (performer on 32 recordings), Victor Miller and His Orchestra (performer on 32 recordings), Joseph Kearns (performer on 31 recordings), Bud Hiestand (announcer on 30 recordings), Hans Conried (performer on 28 recordings), and The Sportsmen (performer on 23 recordings).
